# Model assignment shared by every variant.
#
# Pinned to explicit versioned IDs — never the floating `-latest` aliases — so that
# a run from week 1 stays comparable to a run from week 8 (D3).
#
# Verified available on the free tier by probe on 2026-08-10. Note gemini-2.5-*
# now returns 404 and all Pro models return 429 with `limit: 0`, i.e. Pro is not
# offered on the free tier at all.
name: fallback
description: two-stage + conditional raw-conversation fallback (live regression)

# Probed 2026-08-10. The full-fat flash models (gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.6-flash)
# allow only 20 requests/day on the free tier — not enough for one 50-question run —
# while the flash-lite models are limited per *minute* and not per day. Every role
# therefore runs on flash-lite, on three different models so that each gets its own
# per-model quota pool.
models:
  # P2 ingestion is the heavy consumer; it gets a pool nothing else touches.
  # Needs throughput above all: ~6.1M tokens for one dev-subset pass. Only the
  # 250k-TPM models can do that in minutes rather than hours (gemma's 16k TPM makes
  # the same work a 6.4-hour job regardless of its generous request budget).
  extractor: gemini-3.1-flash-lite
  # The system under test. Held constant across every variant.
  answerer: gemini-3.5-flash-lite
  # A different model from the answerer, so no system grades its own prose.
  # Its own pool, and chosen for the shape of the work rather than its size: judge
  # inputs are ~200 tokens, so the 16k TPM that rules gemma out for extraction is
  # irrelevant here, while its 1,500 requests/day is exactly what judging needs.
  # Keeping judge and extractor on separate pools is what stops a large ingest
  # starving the evaluation (D3).
  judge: gemma-4-31b-it
  embedder: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
  embedding_dim: 384

quota:
  # Per model, not per project — the 429 body reports
  # GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier. The flash-lite extractor
  # has reported 500 RPD; runtime also loads any model-specific learned limit.
  rpm: 10
  tpm: 250000
  rpd: 500
  max_wait_seconds: 300.0

dataset_variant: s
dataset_limit: 50

# P4. Ingestion applies temporal resolution; the eval variant
# `chronomem_no_temporal` reads the same store with the filter off.
temporal_resolution: true

retrieval:
  top_k: 20

# 15, not the 10 D5 chose. With 2,400 namespaced dev-50 sessions, two-stage
# extraction takes 189 namespace-bounded batches / 378 extractor calls before
# deduplication. The measured 500-RPD limit leaves room for the observed dedupe
# calls and retries on
# an otherwise unused quota day; quality risk is small because batch size 10 had
# zero cross-session misattributions.
ingest:
  sessions_per_request: 15
  # Stage A emits bare fact strings, Stage B keys them with a second LLM call.
  # Two requests per batch instead of one: the rule-based Stage B scored 43%
  # predicate accuracy and produced zero supersessions, while this passes the
  # temporal gate on all four metrics.
  two_stage: true
  checkpoint_every: 5
  dedupe_similarity_threshold: 0.92

# Conditional recovery: the answerer returns a verdict, and only `need_source`
# pays for raw text and a second call. Distinct from `hydration`, which attached
# evidence to every answer and was measured at 3x context for no detectable gain
# (results/a2-pilot.md).
fallback:
  enabled: true
  max_turns: 3
  max_chars: 2400

# P6. Session-coherent context, used only by the `two_stage_coherent` variant;
# every other variant ignores this block entirely. These values are the starting
# point, NOT a result: the pre-registration
# (results/prereg-context-shape.md) puts the budget on train150 and freezes it
# before dev100 is touched, and they live here rather than behind a CLI flag so
# that scripts/freeze.py can see them.
#
# The former ~64% Top-3 estimate is superseded: its script mixed incomplete
# questions into the denominator and compared scoped database ids with public ids.
# A partial corrected train150 pass is above the registered 80% bar, but only the
# fixed full-150 grid may select this arm or write configs/v2.yaml.
context:
  max_sessions: 3
  window_radius: null
  max_total_memories: 20
  aggregate: sum_top3
  session_order: chronological
  include_superseded: false
